html:
.demo {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.controls > div {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.controls label {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.controls select {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: var(--control-height);
  padding: 0 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--control-radius);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--foreground);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
.fixtureLabel {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.navigation {
  padding: 8px;
}
.projectMark {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding-inline: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.projectMark > span:first-child {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 500 14px/20px monospace;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.navigation nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}
.navNote {
  margin-top: 32px;
  padding: 8px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.navNote > span {
  font: 12px/16px monospace;
}
.navNote p {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.search {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 320px;
}
.search > svg {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 8px;
  z-index: 1;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.search > input {
  padding-left: 32px;
}
.pageHeader {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.pageHeader > div {
  min-width: 0;
}
.pageHeader h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 28px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.pageHeader p {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.pageContent {
  padding: 16px;
}
.entityList {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.entityList > li {
  min-width: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.fileRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.fileRow > svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.fileRow > span {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.inspectorActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 160px;
  padding: 24px;
  text-align: center;
}
.empty > svg {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.empty h3 {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.empty p {
  max-width: 320px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 30%, var(--border));
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--destructive);
}
.notice {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.skeletons {
  display: grid;
}
.skeletons > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.skeletons span {
  height: 12px;
  width: 65%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--surface-raised);
}
.skeletons span:last-child {
  width: 40%;
}
.caption {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
.caption {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
}
.feedback {
  min-height: 16px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
@container workspace-navigation (max-width: 100px) {
  .navLabel {
    display: none;
  }
  .navigation {
    padding: 4px;
  }
  .projectMark {
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .pageHeader {
    padding: 16px;
  }
  .pageContent {
    padding: 12px;
  }
  .controls {
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .controls > div {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .fixtureLabel {
    margin-left: 0;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .controls select {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
  .search > svg {
    top: 14px;
  }
}

.groupTitle {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.viewSwitch {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
